[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build the artifact-link event snapshot once and reuse its [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]inputs[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]snapshot-reuse[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]Make preview_aggregate build one event snapshot instead of two (resolves[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task bead sase-1rt). Add a scoped, opt-in memo for durable event objects[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the parsed pending outbox, so repeated snapshots inside one publish,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drain, or reconcile stop re-reading and re-validating unchanged inputs.[/#D7D7AF]

      [bold #D7AFFF]caller deadline[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]deadline-aware-aggregate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after snapshot-reuse[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]Make _write_merged_aggregate stop retrying after a lost CAS race when [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]deadline through rebuild_aggregate, reconcile_aggregate, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish-path apply_events_to_aggregate, with typed deferral handling in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]both chops. Add per-sub-phase publish timings.[/#D7D7AF]
